tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window background. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the sidebar, list rows. One step above ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, keycaps, menus and anything that floats above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input wells and the track of a switch. One step below ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, keycaps and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on surface and ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the four sound bars of the mark, on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: voice
tokens.usage: The brand colour and the colour of live speech: the caret bar of the mark, the primary button fill, the listening state. One large voice element per view; small caret marks do not count.

tokens.name: on-voice
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a voice fill.

tokens.name: voice-ink
tokens.usage: Voice-coloured text and links on ground, surface and voice-soft.

tokens.name: voice-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind voice-ink text: the Dictation tag, a selected snippet.

tokens.name: script
tokens.usage: Written text that has landed: the inserted state, success ticks, word counts. Text, icons and strokes on ground, surface and script-soft; never a button fill.

tokens.name: script-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind script text.

tokens.name: command
tokens.usage: Command mode only: the caret and glow of the pill while a spoken instruction is recorded, and the Command tag. Text and strokes on ground, surface and command-soft.

tokens.name: command-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind command text.

tokens.name: think
tokens.usage: Work in progress: transcribing, downloading a model. Text and strokes on ground, surface and think-soft.

tokens.name: think-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind think text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with a word or icon. Text and strokes on ground, surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: overlay-ground
tokens.usage: The dictation pill. It floats over other apps, so it is dark in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay-ink
tokens.usage: Text and sound bars on overlay-ground.

tokens.name: overlay-muted
tokens.usage: Hints on overlay-ground.

tokens.name: overlay-line
tokens.usage: The pill's edge and its keycap borders, so it stays visible on dark wallpapers.

tokens.name: overlay-voice
tokens.usage: Listening caret and glow on overlay-ground.

tokens.name: overlay-command
tokens.usage: Command-mode caret and glow on overlay-ground.

tokens.name: overlay-think
tokens.usage: Writing-state dots and caret on overlay-ground.

tokens.name: overlay-script
tokens.usage: Inserted-state tick and count on overlay-ground.

tokens.name: overlay-danger
tokens.usage: Error state on overlay-ground.

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: Figtree, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per window at most: onboarding and empty states.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The number on a stat card. Tabular figures.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card headings and settings group titles.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Labels of controls, buttons and nav items.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels. Never for sentences.

styles.name: keycap
styles.usage: Keys inside a keycap and app names in history.

styles.name: transcript
styles.sample: um so I think we should ship it
styles.usage: Raw, unprocessed transcripts and anything the user must type exactly.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a keycap and its plus sign; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control group; nav item padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling controls; the pill's inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), list row padding, the pill's side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (comfortable), gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter inside the window.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; distance of the pill from the bottom of the screen.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small bar marks: the caret in a tag, the nav caret, sparkline bars and the pill's sound bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Keycaps and the segments of a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the app window's panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The dictation pill, switches and status tags. Nothing else is fully round.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards that float: menus, dialogs. Flat cards use line only.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The dictation pill, over any wallpaper or app.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback and the sound bars following the microphone.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, colour changes, a cancelled pill fading out.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: State changes inside the pill, switches, page cross-fades.

tokens.name: dur-expand
tokens.usage: The pill growing from rest to listening and shrinking back.

tokens.name: dur-breathe
tokens.usage: One cycle of the caret's breathing glow while listening.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for everything that enters or changes.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: The pill expanding, the switch thumb, the nav caret and the mark rising on first launch. A single small overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things that leave.
